subject.title: fix(google-vertex): add Google Vertex AI onboarding wizard, fix ADC auth, add provider docs

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's Google Vertex ADC setup contract: permissive auth evidence, request-time invalid-ADC failure, setup-written project/location/default model/marker, and manifest `env-vars-with-marker` evidence?
rationale: The patch appears coherent and proven, but it changes provider auth/setup semantics and plugin manifest surface rather than only repairing a local code defect.

options.title: Accept ADC setup contract
options.body: Land after the docs-map repair with maintainers explicitly owning request-time invalid-ADC failures, the global/default-model onboarding writes, and the core fallback routing.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Keep or reintroduce stricter setup evidence, reduce default config writes, or add an explicit strict path before accepting the onboarding behavior.

options.title: Pause behind the Vertex cluster
options.body: Keep this PR open as proof while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/60736 and overlapping Vertex PRs settle the provider boundary first.

recommendation.title: Accept ADC setup contract
recommendation.body: Land after the docs-map repair with maintainers explicitly owning request-time invalid-ADC failures, the global/default-model onboarding writes, and the core fallback routing.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history across setup/catalog onboarding and Google Vertex auth hardening surfaces touched by the product decision.
